Al-Tuḥfah al-Rabbāniyyah (The Divine Gift)
A Commentary on al-Nawawī's Forty Hadiths
Together with a commentary on the hadiths added by Ibn Rajab al-Ḥanbalī
By
His Eminence, the erudite scholar Shaykh Ismāʿīl ibn Muḥammad al-Anṣārī (may Allah have mercy on him)
Researcher at Dār al-Iftāʾ in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

All praise is due to Allah, who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth. We ask Him, exalted be His majesty, to guide us to His straight path and to protect us from the misguidance of those who stir up trials and from the ruinous errors of the deviators. I send blessings and peace upon the one whom Allah sent as a mercy to the worlds,

a guidance and a reminder for the believers, and upon his family and Companions, who strove for Allah as He deserves to be striven for, conveyed the message to all people, and attained honour and happiness in this world and in the Hereafter.

To proceed: Imam al-Nawawī has a firm footing in the purified Sunnah. His works in it are praiseworthy and his standing in it is that of those firmly grounded in the field. He served Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim in the finest way,

offered his book Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn to those who seek reform, and then selected from the authentic collections the famous Forty Hadiths, which the scholars received with acceptance and approval because they comprise the foundations of the rulings and the laws of Islam; and so they undertook to explain and clarify them.
Among the finest of their commentaries is this concise one written by our teacher, Shaykh Ismāʿīl al-Anṣārī (may Allah grant him success). He has done students of knowledge a great kindness

and has arranged the explanation of the aims of each hadith excellently, following the method of deduction after explaining the vocabulary. The points deduced from each hadith are the best distinguishing feature of this beneficial commentary.
We ask Allah the Exalted to make it a righteous deed, done sincerely for His noble Face.
May Allah send blessings and peace upon our master Muḥammad and his family.
We ask Allah the Exalted for success. May Allah send blessings upon our Prophet Muḥammad and upon all his family and Companions.
